value.quote: we characterize prominent proportionality axioms as equilibria of budgeting games
value.note: Main results are correspondences between budgeting-game equilibria and proportionality axioms (EQ/AX), finite improvement of deviation dynamics (EQ), and existence of strong equilibria via the Tree-Sweep algorithm (EQ/AL).

C1.reason: Theorems 6.1 and 6.2 are results about the Tree-Sweep algorithm computing (strong) equilibria, so AL applies to at least one main result alongside EQ and AX, with EQ primary.

value.quote: 1-strong equilibria are more familiarly known as Nash equilibria
value.note: Nash equilibrium (Th. 3.1, 6.1); strong equilibrium, alpha-core, cohesive alpha-core, superset equilibrium (coalitional); sequences of improving deviations / finite improvement property (Th. 5.1, 5.3).

C8.1.reason: Alpha-core, cohesive alpha-core and superset equilibrium are all coalitional-deviation concepts covered by COAL, so B's additional OTH is redundant.
